data.body: Blast-radius follow-up: a second scratch upload from the exact older base named in the report (710a606b6d38) also succeeded normally and created Gerrit change 2814; I abandoned it immediately. Host quick checks show root 32%, /var/gerrit 24%, gate-scratch 29%, Docker build cache 5.8G reclaimable, and server-side git cat-file now resolves both reported missing trees 1959f268... and 1af810df... as tree objects. This makes the active outage non-reproducing at receive-pack as of 02:04 UTC; continuing with log/fsck correlation before any repair.
